authorization: Latest user instruction implement joint-compatible statistic generation without softening physical accounting.

components.prior: Named Gamma(.5+180*leave-player-out same-role count/minute,1+180), then own Poisson count+reported-minute update. Residual Gamma(.5,1) then historical non-named same-team count+reported-minute update.
components.conversions: Named Beta(.5+40*same-role leave-player-out make proportion,.5+40*fail proportion), then own makes/misses; residual Beta(.5,.5)+pooled makes/misses for2PT/3PT/FT.
components.auxiliary: Reuse exact admitted G/OT/minute/copula/assist/rebound/foul-length proxies and restrictions. No new lineup, roster, availability or publication claim.

factorization_limit: Component Gamma-Poisson/Beta-binomial posteriors conditional on reported exposure/attempts are exact for declared working likelihoods. Their modular use in constrained chronological J is not a posterior of the entire observed event process.
mechanism: Sample attempt rates and conversion probabilities once. Derive expected made3=threePA*p3, non3points=2*twoPA*p2+FTA*pFT, PTS=3*made3+non3points, FTshare=FTA*pFT/non3points. Reuse unchanged audited chronological path; its branch weights equal underlying2PA/3PA/FTseries/TO rates. No independent PTS/3PM posterior, no rPTS<3r3 rejection or projection.
S_definition: S4 marginal is a projection of EXACT_SAME_MODEL_AND_SCENARIO_BANK as new J, not independent S1 plus a coupling correction. All8 primitive/combo vectors share scenario IDs; same-stat public S/J queries must match exactly.

inference.stream: Fixed scenario keys use coherent-family namespace; no seed selection after results. Retain all proposals as create-only deterministic gzip raw JSON with both compressed and uncompressed hashes. FixedG/O/parameters never resampled across OT rejects; exhaustion fails whole batch.

acceptance: Unchanged hard physics auditor and old core bytes.
Independent prefit source/contract review before new artifact.
Conjugate parameter values and posterior predictive identities independently checked.
No independent points/threes input accepted; moment constraint compatible by shared construction.
Actual public source->fit->same S/J law->C transport, all140/280 denominators.
PMF/CDF/OUP are Monte Carlo estimates with error bands; zero hits never exact population zero, full population support not replaced by empirical support.
Strict source/model/code/clock/ancestry/version binding; mutations/reject/unknown populations preserved.
metrics: Exact same-bank S/J PMF/CDF/OUP equality (software identity, not predictive quality).
Old S1/newS4 means,CDF/partitionTV with MC uncertainty, no required match of incompatible old marginals.
stop: No new fit if protocol not independently accepted.
No issuance if any scenario fails, source/identity/clock/code fails, or target already started.
No historical replacement fitting, holdout scoring/decompression, weight optimization,NUTS,schedule change,merge,deploy,Tier promotion.
